Renew the domain registration before it lapses.

## Scope BOUNDARY

The renewal only. Moving registrars is not part of this card.

## Acceptance criteria

- The registrar shows a new expiry date at least one year out.
- Auto-renew is switched on.

- `docs/domains.md` — who holds the account
- `docs/runbooks/dns.md` — what to check afterwards
